evals.prompt: Cut a release: promote the [Unreleased] section of CHANGELOG.md to a new version and bump package.json.
evals.expected_output: Gathers state, picks the bump type from commits, promotes Unreleased to a dated version section, and bumps package.json.
assertions: Gathers current version, latest tag and unreleased commit count first
Determines bump from commits: feat is minor, only fix/chore/docs/test/refactor is patch, BREAKING CHANGE or ! is major
Promotes [Unreleased] into a versioned section dated today and leaves a fresh empty [Unreleased]
Follows Keep a Changelog headings (Added, Fixed, Changed)
Bumps the version in package.json to match

evals.prompt: Update the changelog for the next release. This repo uses release-please.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes that release-please owns promotion in this repo and does not run the promote flow.
assertions: Notes that in release-please repos the release PR owns changelog promotion, version bump and tag
Does not hand-promote [Unreleased] or bump the version in that repo
May still append-only entries under [Unreleased] when asked via pr-to-release

evals.prompt: Add a Usage section to the README explaining the CLI flags.
evals.expected_output: Documentation edit unrelated to changelog or versioning.
assertions: Does not compute a version bump
